push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.8 against SydSwny FanClub. If football were a garden, you'd be the tomatoes.

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes. You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ A goal against SydSwny FanClub, your first since Oct 4. Somebody check the net for scorch marks.
+ Your vision plus PhogsToffees's finishing equals a very happy coach.
+ 1.1 above your norm. That's what effort compounds into.
+ 8.8: your 5th best match performance. Remember how that felt.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted. Write this down: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal. Easy money.
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Remember this: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. No sweat, just reps.
- 6 misplaced passes cost 0.2. Smarter choices fix it.
- Pass accuracy: 74%. A few steps from the 87%+ club.
- Passes attempted: 23. 25+ is where top midfielders hang their hats.

Skill builder: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: Win the next five seconds, then the next five.

Nothing but pride over here. - Coach Lasso
